name: cool
description: Record what AI agents do as signed, tamper-evident receipts and verify them offline.
long_description: CooL records agent actions as signed receipts inside a project folder you choose (in .cool/ there). Each receipt carries ML-DSA-65 + Ed25519 signatures and a sequence number, so gaps show. Inputs and outputs are kept only as keyed digests. CooL seals the receipts into a Merkle-tree bundle that anyone can verify offline with one command. It proves the record was not altered. It does not prove that every action was recorded, and agent identities are declared, not authenticated. Experimental.

workspace.title: Project folder
workspace.description: The one folder CooL may write receipts into. It creates .cool/ there. Do not choose your home folder or a drive root.

tools.name: cool_record_change
tools.description: Record one agent action as a signed receipt

tools.name: cool_seal_log
tools.description: Seal all receipts into a portable bundle

tools.name: cool_verify_receipt
tools.description: Verify a bundle offline: VALID, INVALID or INDETERMINATE

tools.name: cool_status
tools.description: Receipts, problems and the key fingerprint
